Thanks — and great question. Short answer: yes, we can provide an operational evidence pack plus an SFTP-based fallback for export/proof. I outlined a proposed deliverable list below to match procurement's ask.

Proposed deliverables for your DPA appendix (by 2028-03-07):
1) No-Learning Evidence Checklist (signed by Ops) — describes capture controls, KV/ephemeral handling, and non-persistent telemetry.
2) Operational export runbook — API export + SFTP fallback instructions, retention/TTL details, proof-of-deletion steps.
3) Subprocessor map snapshot (filtered to what touches HealthBridge data).
4) Attestation letter from Privacy Ops confirming "no-model-learning" toggle is enforced for your tenant and audited weekly.

David and Kimberly — tagging you to confirm we can produce the checklist and the SFTP deletion proof by EOD 3/7. If SFTP requires a separate ops ticket for onshore staging, flag timing.

Elena — if that covers procurement, I’ll attach the checklist + runbook to a short cover note. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want faster alignment.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: No-model-learning opt-out — evidence & EU residency question

Marissa / Elena —

Notes from Ops & Privacy Ops (technical):

1) Evidence artefacts we can deliver (final PDFs / signed attestations):
   - Weekly audit export snapshot that shows the tenant-level config (no-learn toggle = true) and a time series of audit logs for the preceding 30 days.
   - Hash-signed export manifest for any exported records (for chain-of-custody).
   - Subprocessor snapshot with access scopes and datacenter regions.

2) Residency & processing paths:
   - For EU customers we normally route processing to EU regions by default; ephemeral inference data (prompts + responses) are kept in-memory and not persisted to training stores when the no-learn toggle is enabled.
   - For customers requiring contractual proof we can stage an onshore/export lane: we will produce the evidence pack from the EU region and, if required, push a certified export to your SFTP endpoint hosted in the EU.

3) SFTP fallback mechanics and proof-of-deletion:
   - We will deposit a time-stamped, hash-signed bundle to your SFTP.
   - After you confirm ingest, we will emit a signed deletion manifest (signed by our ops mailbox) and a corresponding audit log entry showing deletion tasks completed.

4) Constraints / timing:
   - We can prepare the evidence checklist + signed attestation by 2028-03-06 EOD.
   - SFTP hookup (customer-side host allowlist + outbound firewall rules) often takes 48–72 hours; if you can provide an SFTP endpoint and allowlist IPs by 3/2, we can meet the 3/7 deadline.

Action items:
- Elena: share SFTP hostname / credentials (we accept per-your-policy certs or password) or confirm API export is acceptable.
- Marissa: I’ll prepare the checklist + attestation draft and share for legal/privacy redline.

On the contract language side: legal often asks for a short clause that references the attestation docs and the DPA appendix. Kimberly — can you propose the contract snippet (one paragraph) we can suggest?

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
